name: Greater Arcane Strike
body:
Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast 3rd level arcane spells, Arcane Strike

Benefit(s): The bonus damage granted by your Arcane Strike feat is increased by 3 points. In addition, when you activate your Arcane Strike you can choose to reduce its bonus damage. For every 2 points you reduce the damage by (to a minimum of 0), you gain a cumulative +1 (circumstance) bonus to hit with your imbued weapons.
